---
title: "test-coverage.yml"
---

Measure R-package test coverage with [`{covr}`](https://covr.r-lib.org/) and upload the Cobertura report to [Codecov](https://about.codecov.io/).
Adapts the [`r-lib/actions`](https://github.com/r-lib/actions) `test-coverage.yaml` example into the repo's composite-plus-wrapper shape.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | `'.'` | Path to the R package root (the directory holding `DESCRIPTION`). |
| `install-quarto` | boolean | `false` | Install Quarto when setting up R dependencies. |
| `extra-packages` | string | `''` | Extra R packages for the coverage run (`covr` and `xml2` are always installed). |

## Secrets

| Secret | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CODECOV_TOKEN` | No | Codecov upload token. Optional for public repos, but recommended -- tokenless uploads are rate-limited and unreliable from pull requests. |

`fail_ci_if_error` defaults to the r-lib heuristic: fail on non-PR events, and on pull requests only when a token is configured.

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/test-coverage.yml in your repo.
name: Test coverage

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test-coverage:
    uses: d-morrison/gha/.github/workflows/test-coverage.yml@v1
    secrets:
      CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
    # with:
    #   path: '.'                  # package root, if not the repo root
    #   install-quarto: false      # set true if vignettes need Quarto to build
    #   extra-packages: ''         # extra R packages for the coverage run
```

See [`examples/test-coverage.yml`](https://github.com/d-morrison/gha/blob/main/examples/test-coverage.yml)
for the full caller stub.
